== ConLeche/Denotes.lean#L270-L290
   270  structure Model (V : Type w) [SetTheory V] (env : Env) where
   271    /-- the set a constant denotes, per level assignment -/
   272    cval : Name → (LevelParam → Nat) → V
   273    /-- every stored constant is a member of what its type denotes, at
   274    every level assignment (and every variable environment — the type
   275    is closed) -/
   276    mem : ∀ c ∈ env.consts, ∀ (φ : LevelParam → Nat) (ρ : BVarIdx → V),
   277      ∃ T, Denotes cval env φ ρ c.toConstantVal.type T ∧ cval c.name φ ∈ˢ T
   278    /-- whatever the built-in `False` denotes is the empty set -/
   279    false_empty : ∀ (φ : LevelParam → Nat) (ρ : BVarIdx → V) (F : V),
   280      Denotes cval env φ ρ (.const falseName []) F → F = empty
   281    /-- whatever the built-in `Eq` denotes is set equality: at a type `A`
   282    of the universe the level `u` names, and two of its members `a` and
   283    `b`, `@Eq.{u} A a b` denotes the truth value of `a = b`.  The three
   284    membership premises are the graph's domains — `Eq`'s denotation is a
   285    three-fold graph over `univ (Level.eval φ u)`, then over `A`, then
   286    over `A` again, and a graph read off its domain says nothing -/
   287    eq_equality : ∀ (u : Level) (φ : LevelParam → Nat) (ρ : BVarIdx → V) (E A a b : V),
   288      Denotes cval env φ ρ (.const eqName [u]) E →
   289      A ∈ˢ univ (Level.eval φ u) → a ∈ˢ A → b ∈ˢ A →
   290      app (app (app E A) a) b = eqv a b

== ConLeche/Cached/Installed.lean#L200-L208
   200  inductive InstallRun (pins : List NatOpPinSet) :
   201      List Declaration → (Nat × FEnv × Array PendingCheck) → CState →
   202      (Nat × FEnv × Array PendingCheck) → CState → Prop where
   203    | nil (p : Nat × FEnv × Array PendingCheck) (s : CState) :
   204        InstallRun pins [] p s p s
   205    | cons {pd : Declaration} {ds : List Declaration} {p p₁ p' : Nat × FEnv × Array PendingCheck}
   206        {s s₁ s' : CState} (h : annotDeclStep mode pins p pd s = .ok (p₁, s₁))
   207        (rest : InstallRun pins ds p₁ s₁ p' s') :
   208        InstallRun pins (pd :: ds) p s p' s'

== ConLeche/Cached/Installed.lean#L275-L279
   275  def GroupChecked {pins : List NatOpPinSet} {ds : List Declaration}
   276      (e : InstalledEnv mode pins ds) (i : Nat) : Prop :=
   277    match e.pend[i]? with
   278    | some pc => ∃ s', checkPending mode e.fe pc {} = .ok ((), s')
   279    | none => True

== ConLeche/Kernel/PropWhen.lean#L1-L40
     1  module
     2  
     3  public import ConLeche.Kernel.Name
     4  
     5  /-!
     6  # The zero-ness datum `PropWhen` — representation, API and laws
     7  (task #161; the small-list constructors, 2026-09-06; the canonical
     8  representation, task #194, 2026-09-06)
     9  
    10  The binder annotation of the validated-annotation design: the reading
    11  of a codomain sort's zero-ness predicate `Z(l) = {φ | eval φ l = 0}`.
    12  
    13  **This module is the datum's whole boundary.**  It owns the
    14  representation, the API that is the only way to build, read and
    15  compare a datum, and — following the `Std.HashMap` pattern that
    16  `CLAUDE.md` licenses for a self-contained data-structure verification
    17  — every law about the datum *alone*.  Downstream never re-proves them
    18  and never sees a constructor:
    19  
    20  * the readout `holds` and its algebra (`holds_inter`,
    21    `holds_bindZ_go`, `holds_ext`);
    22  * the comparison — which is **equality**: `=`/`==`/`DecidableEq`
    23    decide zero-ness agreement at every valuation (`eq_iff_holds`), so
    24    the checker's validation and defeq sites compare with `==` and no
    25    separate comparison exists (task #197);
    26  * the `inter`/`bindZ` algebra the substitution laws rest on
    27    (`inter_assoc`, `bindZ_inter`, `bindZ_go_append`,
    28    `bindZ_congr_names`, `bindZ_unit`, `paramsDefined_inter_of`).
    29  
    30  **Canonical by construction (task #194).**  Every value of the type is
    31  the unique representative of its parameter *set*: the parameter list
    32  is strictly ascending in a total order on names (`Name.cmp`, defined
    33  here), the invariant is carried by the constructors themselves, and
    34  every producer (`ifAllZero`, `inter`, `bindZ`, hence
    35  `Level.zeronessOf`/`Level.substPW`) normalizes.  Consequently
    36  `ifAllZero ps = ifAllZero qs ↔ (∀ n, n ∈ ps ↔ n ∈ qs)`
    37  (`ifAllZero_eq_iff`), `=`/`==`/`DecidableEq`/`Hashable` all decide
    38  zero-ness agreement, and the level-instantiation identity law
    39  (`Level.substPW_self`, `ConLeche/Verify/PropWhen.lean`) holds
    40  unconditionally — amendment 2's counterexample (DESIGN.md, task #161

== ConLeche/Kernel/Exclusive.lean#L6-L42
     6  # `withExclusive`: the reference-count read behind the walk memo
     7  
     8  **What it is.**  `withExclusive a k h` runs the continuation `k` on
     9  whether the object `a` is *exclusive* — single-threaded with reference
    10  count exactly 1, so that no other reference to it exists.  In the logic
    11  it is `k false` ("not known to be exclusive", the conservative answer);
    12  in compiled code `@[implemented_by]` substitutes `k
    13  (isExclusiveUnsafe a)`, the real count read off the object header
    14  (`Init/Util.lean`, `@[extern "lean_is_exclusive_obj"]`, a BORROWED
    15  parameter; `lean_is_exclusive` in `lean.h`).  A multi-threaded object
    16  (count `< 0`) and a persistent one (count `0` — the installed
    17  environment after the driver's `Runtime.markPersistent`) answer
    18  `false`, which is the safe side.
    19  
    20  **What licenses the substitution** is the obligation
    21  
    22  ```
    23  h : k true = k false
    24  ```
    25  
    26  — the continuation's value does not depend on the answer, so the
    27  compiled program computes the very value the definition names.  A
    28  caller may use the answer to choose *how* to compute a value, never
    29  *which* value.  `Init.Util`'s `withPtrAddr` is the same arrangement
    30  (`k 0` in the model, the address in the binary, the continuation
    31  address-blind by obligation), and `Bool` being two-valued makes
    32  `k true = k false` the whole of `∀ b₁ b₂, k b₁ = k b₂`.
    33  
    34  **What it is for.**  The per-walk memo tables of the substitution walks
    35  (`ConLeche/Cached/ExprOpsC.lean`) exist for one reason: a node reached
    36  twice — a shared sub-DAG — must be rebuilt once, so that the walk is
    37  `O(DAG)` and its OUTPUT stays shared.  A node with exactly one
    38  reference cannot be reached twice, so recording it is pure loss: the
    39  key, the entry, the probe.  The official kernel's `replace_fn`
    40  (`src/kernel/replace_fn.cpp`) therefore caches a node's replacement
    41  only when `!is_likely_unshared(e)` — the same read.  The walks memoise
    42  exactly the nodes this primitive reports shared.

== ConLeche/Term/Syntax.lean#L187-L215
   187  inductive Term where
   188    /-- de Bruijn index -/
   189    | bvar (i : Nat)
   190    /-- `Sort u` at a concrete level -/
   191    | sort (u : Nat)
   192    /-- a built-in constant at a concrete level instantiation -/
   193    | const (c : BConst) (us : List Nat)
   194    /-- application -/
   195    | app (f a : Term)
   196    /-- `fun (_ : ty) => body` -/
   197    | lam (ty body : Term)
   198    /-- `(_ : ty) → body` -/
   199    | pi (ty body : Term)
   200    /-- `@Eq _ lhs rhs`, **without the type**: the interpretation is
   201    `⟦eqE a b⟧ = eqv ⟦a⟧ ⟦b⟧`, so soundness never constrains the type,
   202    and a census (task #237) found no definition and no theorem in any
   203    tier reading the slot the former used to carry.  It is gone; a
   204    producer that knows the type simply drops it. -/
   205    | eqE (lhs rhs : Term)
   206    /-- First field of a pair.  Carries **only** the subject: the pair's
   207    type arguments come from the typing premise `Γ ⊢ p : Σ A B`,
   208    not from the term — see the module docstring.  Interpreted by
   209    `sfst`, i.e. literally `interp`'s clause. -/
   210    | fst (e : Term)
   211    /-- Second field of a pair; the `fst` twin, interpreted by `ssnd`. -/
   212    | snd (e : Term)
   213    /-- the canonical (irrelevant) proof of a derivable equation -/
   214    | prf
   215    deriving Repr, Inhabited

== ConLeche/Semantics/Syntax.lean#L72-L98
    72    | const (c : BConst) (us : List Nat)
    73    /-- application -/
    74    | app (f a : AnnotTerm)
    75    /-- `fun (_ : ty) => body`, where `body`'s **type** has sort `u` —
    76    the codomain numeral `interp` dispatches on (tier B's F4; the
    77    #152 resolution made it derivable, and `Annotates.lam` caches it) -/
    78    | lam (u : Nat) (ty body : AnnotTerm)
    79    /-- `(_ : ty) → body`, with `ty`'s sort `u` and `body`'s sort `v` -/
    80    | pi (u v : Nat) (ty body : AnnotTerm)
    81    /-- `@Eq _ lhs rhs`; no annotation, and no type slot either, as in
    82    `Term` (task #237) -/
    83    | eqE (lhs rhs : AnnotTerm)
    84    /-- first field of a pair -/
    85    | fst (e : AnnotTerm)
    86    /-- second field of a pair -/
    87    | snd (e : AnnotTerm)
    88    /-- the canonical (irrelevant) proof of a derivable equation -/
    89    | prf
    90    deriving Repr, Inhabited
    91  
    92  namespace AnnotTerm
    93  
    94  /-- Forget the annotations. -/
    95  def erase : AnnotTerm → Term
    96    | .bvar i => .bvar i
    97    | .sort u => .sort u
    98    | .const c us => .const c us

== ConLeche/Semantics/WellDenoted.lean#L56-L86
    56  def WellDenoted : (Nat → V) → AnnotTerm → Prop
    57    | ρ, .pi _u _v A B =>
    58      WellDenoted ρ A ∧
    59      ∀ x, x ∈ˢ interp V ρ A → WellDenoted (cons x ρ) B
    60    | ρ, .lam v A b =>
    61      WellDenoted ρ A ∧
    62      (∀ x, x ∈ˢ interp V ρ A → WellDenoted (cons x ρ) b) ∧
    63      ∃ B : V → V,
    64        (∀ x, x ∈ˢ interp V ρ A → interp V (cons x ρ) b ∈ˢ B x) ∧
    65        (v = 0 → ∀ x, x ∈ˢ interp V ρ A → B x ∈ˢ (univZero : V))
    66    | ρ, .app f a =>
    67      WellDenoted ρ f ∧ WellDenoted ρ a ∧
    68      ∃ (v : Nat) (A : V) (B : V → V),
    69        interp V ρ f ∈ˢ piR v A B ∧ interp V ρ a ∈ˢ A ∧
    70        (v = 0 → ∀ x, x ∈ˢ A → B x ∈ˢ (univZero : V))
    71    | ρ, .fst e =>
    72      WellDenoted ρ e ∧
    73      ∃ u v A Bf, interp V ρ e ∈ˢ sigmaSet (Nat.max u v) A Bf ∧
    74        A ∈ˢ univ u ∧ ∀ x, x ∈ˢ A → Bf x ∈ˢ univ v
    75    | ρ, .snd e =>
    76      WellDenoted ρ e ∧
    77      ∃ u v A Bf, interp V ρ e ∈ˢ sigmaSet (Nat.max u v) A Bf ∧
    78        A ∈ˢ univ u ∧ ∀ x, x ∈ˢ A → Bf x ∈ˢ univ v
    79    | ρ, .eqE a b => WellDenoted ρ a ∧ WellDenoted ρ b
    80    | _, .bvar _ => True
    81    | _, .sort _ => True
    82    | _, .const _ _ => True
    83    | _, .prf => True

== ConLeche/Semantics/WellDenoted.lean#L133-L301

   135  /-- Truthfulness through lifting. -/
   136  theorem WellDenoted_liftN (n : Nat) :
   137      ∀ (e : AnnotTerm) (k : Nat) (ρ : Nat → V),
   138        WellDenoted V ρ (e.liftN n k) ↔ WellDenoted V (shiftE n k ρ) e := by
   139    intro e
   140    induction e with
   141    | bvar i =>
   142      intro k ρ
   143      simp only [AnnotTerm.liftN_bvar]
   144      split <;> simp
   145    | sort u => intro k ρ; simp
   146    | const c us => intro k ρ; simp
   147    | app f a ihf iha =>
   148      intro k ρ
   149      rw [AnnotTerm.liftN_app, WellDenoted_app, WellDenoted_app, ihf, iha,
   150        interp_liftN, interp_liftN]
   151    | lam v A b ihA ihb =>
   152      intro k ρ
   153      rw [AnnotTerm.liftN_lam, WellDenoted_lam, WellDenoted_lam, ihA, interp_liftN]
   154      refine and_congr Iff.rfl (and_congr
   155        (forall_congr' fun x => imp_congr Iff.rfl ?_)
   156        (exists_congr fun B => and_congr
   157          (forall_congr' fun x => imp_congr Iff.rfl ?_) Iff.rfl))
   158      · rw [ihb, cons_shiftE]
   159      · rw [interp_liftN, cons_shiftE]
   160    | pi u v A B ihA ihB =>
   161      intro k ρ
   162      rw [AnnotTerm.liftN_pi, WellDenoted_pi, WellDenoted_pi, ihA, interp_liftN]
   163      refine and_congr Iff.rfl (forall_congr' fun x => imp_congr Iff.rfl ?_)
   164      rw [ihB, cons_shiftE]
   165    | eqE a b iha ihb =>
   166      intro k ρ
   167      rw [AnnotTerm.liftN_eqE, WellDenoted_eqE, WellDenoted_eqE, iha, ihb]
   168    | fst e ihe =>
   169      intro k ρ
   170      rw [AnnotTerm.liftN_fst, WellDenoted_fst, WellDenoted_fst, ihe,
   171        interp_liftN]
   172    | snd e ihe =>
   173      intro k ρ
   174      rw [AnnotTerm.liftN_snd, WellDenoted_snd, WellDenoted_snd, ihe,
   175        interp_liftN]
   176    | prf => intro k ρ; simp

   178  /-- Truthfulness through instantiation. -/
   179  theorem WellDenoted_inst :
   180      ∀ (e a : AnnotTerm) (k : Nat) (ρ : Nat → V),
   181        WellDenoted V (shiftE k 0 ρ) a →
   182        (WellDenoted V ρ (e.inst a k) ↔
   183          WellDenoted V (instE k (interp V (shiftE k 0 ρ) a) ρ) e) := by
   184    intro e
   185    induction e with
   186    | bvar i =>
   187      intro a k ρ ha
   188      show WellDenoted V ρ
   189          (if i < k then .bvar i
   190           else if i = k then AnnotTerm.liftN k a else .bvar (i - 1)) ↔ _
   191      by_cases h : i < k
   192      · simp [if_pos h]
   193      · by_cases h2 : i = k
   194        · simp only [if_neg h, if_pos h2, WellDenoted_bvar, iff_true]
   195          exact (WellDenoted_liftN V k a 0 ρ).mpr ha
   196        · simp [if_neg h, if_neg h2]
   197    | sort u => intro a k ρ _; simp [AnnotTerm.inst]
   198    | const c us => intro a k ρ _; simp [AnnotTerm.inst]
   199    | app f b ihf ihb =>
   200      intro a k ρ ha
   201      rw [AnnotTerm.inst_app, WellDenoted_app, WellDenoted_app, ihf a k ρ ha,
   202        ihb a k ρ ha, interp_inst, interp_inst]
   203    | lam v A b ihA ihb =>
   204      intro a k ρ ha
   205      rw [AnnotTerm.inst_lam, WellDenoted_lam, WellDenoted_lam, ihA a k ρ ha,
   206        interp_inst]
   207      refine and_congr Iff.rfl (and_congr
   208        (forall_congr' fun x => imp_congr Iff.rfl ?_)
   209        (exists_congr fun B => and_congr
   210          (forall_congr' fun x => imp_congr Iff.rfl ?_) Iff.rfl))
   211      · have ha' : WellDenoted V (shiftE (k + 1) 0 (cons x ρ)) a := by
   212          rw [shiftE_succ_cons]; exact ha
   213        rw [ihb a (k + 1) (cons x ρ) ha', shiftE_succ_cons, cons_instE]
   214      · have ha' : WellDenoted V (shiftE (k + 1) 0 (cons x ρ)) a := by
   215          rw [shiftE_succ_cons]; exact ha
   216        rw [interp_inst, shiftE_succ_cons, cons_instE]
   217    | pi u v A B ihA ihB =>
   218      intro a k ρ ha
   219      rw [AnnotTerm.inst_pi, WellDenoted_pi, WellDenoted_pi, ihA a k ρ ha,
   220        interp_inst]
   221      refine and_congr Iff.rfl (forall_congr' fun x => imp_congr Iff.rfl ?_)
   222      have ha' : WellDenoted V (shiftE (k + 1) 0 (cons x ρ)) a := by
   223        rw [shiftE_succ_cons]; exact ha
   224      rw [ihB a (k + 1) (cons x ρ) ha', shiftE_succ_cons, cons_instE]
   225    | eqE x y ihx ihy =>
   226      intro a k ρ ha
   227      rw [AnnotTerm.inst_eqE, WellDenoted_eqE, WellDenoted_eqE, ihx a k ρ ha,
   228        ihy a k ρ ha]
   229    | fst e ihe =>
   230      intro a k ρ ha
   231      rw [AnnotTerm.inst_fst, WellDenoted_fst, WellDenoted_fst, ihe a k ρ ha,
   232        interp_inst]
   233    | snd e ihe =>
   234      intro a k ρ ha
   235      rw [AnnotTerm.inst_snd, WellDenoted_snd, WellDenoted_snd, ihe a k ρ ha,
   236        interp_inst]
   237    | prf => intro a k ρ _; simp [AnnotTerm.inst]
   238  
   239  /-- Substitution at the outermost binder — the β/ζ transport form. -/
   240  theorem WellDenoted_inst0 {e a : AnnotTerm} {ρ : Nat → V}
   241      (ha : WellDenoted V ρ a) :
   242      WellDenoted V ρ (e.inst a) ↔
   243        WellDenoted V (cons (interp V ρ a) ρ) e := by
   244    have h := WellDenoted_inst V e a 0 ρ (by rwa [shiftE_zero_zero])
   245    rwa [shiftE_zero_zero, instE_zero] at h
   246  
   247  /-! ### The graded β step, complete
   248  
   249  `Red`'s β cases in both conjuncts, at a provably-positive codomain
   250  kind: the interp-equality *and* the truthfulness transport, from the
   251  subject's `WellDenoted` alone — no argument re-check.  This is the
   252  family-2 removal's core theorem; `app_lamR_pos`
   253  (`SetModel/Ops.lean`) is its value-level kernel.  At kind `0` the domain
   254  membership is not recoverable (impredicativity — the #49/#73 residue),
   255  which is why the runtime gate is a kind test, not a deletion. -/
   256  theorem WellDenoted_beta_pos {v : Nat} (hv : v ≠ 0) {A b a : AnnotTerm}
   257      {ρ : Nat → V}
   258      (h : WellDenoted V ρ (.app (.lam v A b) a)) :
   259      interp V ρ (.app (.lam v A b) a) = interp V ρ (b.inst a) ∧
   260      WellDenoted V ρ (b.inst a) := by
   261    rw [WellDenoted_app] at h
   262    obtain ⟨hlam, ha, v', A', B', hslot, hmem, -⟩ := h
   263    rw [WellDenoted_lam] at hlam
   264    obtain ⟨-, hbody, B, hfib, -⟩ := hlam
   265    -- the slot's product is in the graph regime: the λ is not `pt`
   266    have hv' : v' ≠ 0 := by
   267      intro h0
   268      subst h0
   269      have h1 := eq_pt_of_mem_piR_zero hslot
   270      rw [interp_lam] at h1
   271      exact lamR_ne_pt hv h1
   272    -- rigidity pins the slot's domain to the λ's own
   273    have hown : interp V ρ (.lam v A b)
   274        ∈ˢ piR v (interp V ρ A) B := by
   275      rw [interp_lam]
   276      exact lamR_mem hfib
   277    have hAA : interp V ρ A = A' := piR_dom_unique hv hv' hown hslot
   278    have haA : interp V ρ a ∈ˢ interp V ρ A := by
   279      rw [hAA]
   280      exact hmem
   281    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
   282    · rw [interp_app, interp_lam, app_lamR_pos hv haA, interp_inst0]
   283    · exact (WellDenoted_inst0 V ha).mpr (hbody _ haA)
   284  
   285  
   286  /-- The graded β step at kind `0` — the residue side: with the
   287  argument membership supplied (the retained `Prop`-codomain runtime
   288  check's fact), the equality holds because both sides are the canonical
   289  proof, and the transport is the hereditary component. -/
   290  theorem WellDenoted_beta_zero {A b a : AnnotTerm} {ρ : Nat → V}
   291      (h : WellDenoted V ρ (.app (.lam 0 A b) a))
   292      (hmem : interp V ρ a ∈ˢ interp V ρ A) :
   293      interp V ρ (.app (.lam 0 A b) a) = interp V ρ (b.inst a) ∧
   294      WellDenoted V ρ (b.inst a) := by
   295    rw [WellDenoted_app] at h
   296    obtain ⟨hlam, ha, -⟩ := h
   297    rw [WellDenoted_lam] at hlam
   298    obtain ⟨-, hbody, B, hfib, hz⟩ := hlam
   299    refine ⟨?_, (WellDenoted_inst0 V ha).mpr (hbody _ hmem)⟩
   300    rw [interp_app, interp_lam, lamR_zero, app_pt, interp_inst0]
   301    exact (eq_pt_of_mem_univZero (hz rfl _ hmem) (hfib _ hmem)).symm

== ConLeche/Model/Annot/EnvModel.lean#L38-L67
    38  structure EnvModel (env : Env) where
    39    /-- the shared, model-free environment well-formedness -/
    40    wf : EnvWF env
    41    /-- the annotated valuation -/

    43    /-- every erased leaf is closed; consumers read the `cvalE`-spelled `cval_closed` below -/
    44    cval_closedL : ∀ (n : Name) (ψ : Name → Nat),
    45      Term.Closed ((acval n ψ).erase)
    46    /-- the reserved basis constants are the pinned declarations, valued
    47    by their direct pins (V-free); consumers
    48    read the `cvalE`-spelled `basis_pinned` below -/
    49    basis_pinnedL : BasisPinnedTT env (fun n ψ => (acval n ψ).erase)
    50    /-- every stored native projection-table entry is a pinned pair
    51    entry with its block stored (V-free, shared) -/
    52    proj_ok : ProjOkT env
    53    /-- every stored recursor rule's constructor is stored (V-free,
    54    shared) -/
    55    rec_ctors : RecCtorsStored env
    56    /-- every leaf is closed, as a lifting equation -/
    57    acval_closed : ∀ (n : Name) (ψ : Name → Nat) (k : Nat),
    58      (acval n ψ).liftN 1 k = acval n ψ
    59    /-- a leaf reads only its own level parameters -/
    60    acval_params : ∀ (n : Name) (ci : ConstantInfo),
    61      env.find? n = some ci →
    62      ∀ ψ₁ ψ₂ : Name → Nat,
    63        (∀ p ∈ ci.toConstantVal.levelParams, ψ₁ p = ψ₂ p) →
    64        acval n ψ₁ = acval n ψ₂
    65    /-- every leaf is truthful -/
    66    acval_wellDenoted : ∀ (n : Name) (ψ : Name → Nat) (ρ : Nat → V),
    67      WellDenoted V ρ (acval n ψ)

== ConLeche/Model/Claims.lean#L47-L113
    47  /-- Head normalisation, dual success, P currency. -/
    48  @[expose] def WhnfCoreClaim (μ : CheckMode) {env : Env} (m : EnvModel V env)
    49      (φ : Name → Nat) (fuel : Nat) : Prop :=
    50    ∀ {d : Nat} {e e' : Expr} {Δa : List AnnotTerm},
    51      whnfCore μ env fuel d e = .ok e' →
    52      Expr.WScoped d e → e.looseBVarsBounded 0 = true →
    53      Expr.LeavesBounded e →
    54      ∀ {ea ea' : AnnotTerm},
    55        CtxOk m φ d Δa e →
    56        denoteMeta m.acval env φ d e = some ea →
    57        denoteMeta m.acval env φ d e' = some ea' →
    58        (∀ ρ : Nat → V, Sat V Δa ρ → WellDenotedV V ρ ea) →
    59        (∀ ρ : Nat → V, Sat V Δa ρ → WellDenotedV V ρ ea') ∧
    60          ∀ ρ : Nat → V, Sat V Δa ρ →
    61            interp V ρ ea = interp V ρ ea'
    62  
    63  /-- The reduction loop, dual success, P currency. -/
    64  @[expose] def WhnfClaim (μ : CheckMode) {env : Env} (m : EnvModel V env)
    65      (φ : Name → Nat) (fuel : Nat) : Prop :=
    66    ∀ {d : Nat} {e e' : Expr} {Δa : List AnnotTerm},
    67      whnf μ env fuel d e = .ok e' →
    68      Expr.WScoped d e → e.looseBVarsBounded 0 = true →
    69      Expr.LeavesBounded e →
    70      ∀ {ea ea' : AnnotTerm},
    71        CtxOk m φ d Δa e →
    72        denoteMeta m.acval env φ d e = some ea →
    73        denoteMeta m.acval env φ d e' = some ea' →
    74        (∀ ρ : Nat → V, Sat V Δa ρ → WellDenotedV V ρ ea) →
    75        (∀ ρ : Nat → V, Sat V Δa ρ → WellDenotedV V ρ ea') ∧
    76          ∀ ρ : Nat → V, Sat V Δa ρ →
    77            interp V ρ ea = interp V ρ ea'
    78  
    79  /-- Definitional equality, P currency. -/
    80  @[expose] def DefEqClaim (μ : CheckMode) {env : Env} (m : EnvModel V env)
    81      (φ : Name → Nat) (fuel : Nat) : Prop :=
    82    ∀ {d : Nat} {a b : Expr} {Δa : List AnnotTerm},
    83      ConLeche.isDefEqCore μ env fuel d a b = .ok true →
    84      Expr.WScoped d a → a.looseBVarsBounded 0 = true →
    85      Expr.LeavesBounded a →
    86      Expr.WScoped d b → b.looseBVarsBounded 0 = true →
    87      Expr.LeavesBounded b →
    88      ∀ {aa ba : AnnotTerm},
    89        CtxOk m φ d Δa a →
    90        CtxOk m φ d Δa b →
    91        denoteMeta m.acval env φ d a = some aa →
    92        denoteMeta m.acval env φ d b = some ba →
    93        (∀ ρ : Nat → V, Sat V Δa ρ → WellDenotedV V ρ aa) →
    94        (∀ ρ : Nat → V, Sat V Δa ρ → WellDenotedV V ρ ba) →
    95        ∀ ρ : Nat → V, Sat V Δa ρ →
    96          interp V ρ aa = interp V ρ ba
    97  
    98  /-- Inference, dual success, P currency: the subject's and the
    99  type's truthfulness — bit validity included — are *conclusions*. -/
   100  @[expose] def InferClaim (μ : CheckMode) {env : Env} (m : EnvModel V env)
   101      (φ : Name → Nat) (fuel : Nat) : Prop :=
   102    ∀ {d : Nat} {e t : Expr} {Δa : List AnnotTerm},
   103      inferTypeCore μ env fuel d e = .ok t →
   104      Expr.WScoped d e → e.looseBVarsBounded 0 = true →
   105      Expr.LeavesBounded e →
   106      ∀ {ea ta : AnnotTerm},
   107        CtxOk m φ d Δa e →
   108        denoteMeta m.acval env φ d e = some ea →
   109        denoteMeta m.acval env φ d t = some ta →
   110        (∀ ρ : Nat → V, Sat V Δa ρ → WellDenotedV V ρ ea) ∧
   111          (∀ ρ : Nat → V, Sat V Δa ρ → WellDenotedV V ρ ta) ∧
   112          ∀ ρ : Nat → V, Sat V Δa ρ →
   113            interp V ρ ea ∈ˢ interp V ρ ta

== ConLeche/Rules/Rel.lean#L310-L333
   310  /-- **Definitional equality**: the verdict `true` of `isDefEq`.
   311  
   312  **There is no `trans` rule, deliberately, and none can be added**
   313  (task #309, the experiment recorded in DESIGN.md).  The relation is
   314  not an equivalence on terms: it is the checker's verdict, and the
   315  checker only ever compares terms that are well-formed *together* — a
   316  fact the rules never state, because well-formedness (scoping, the
   317  readability of annotations, the grading of the reading) is semantic
   318  and may not enter this inductive.  Every rule respects one syntactic
   319  discipline instead: **the subject of each `DefEq` premise is either a
   320  subterm of the conclusion or is produced by an existence-form `Red` /
   321  `Infer` premise** (a reduct, an inferred type), so the soundness proof
   322  (`ConLeche/Model/Rules/Sound.lean`) always has the premise's terms in
   323  hand.  `trans` is the unique rule that would break it: its middle
   324  term comes from nowhere, and with it two rules that are each sound
   325  alone meet — `fvar` compares free variables by index only (their
   326  annotations are not compared, as the checker does not), while
   327  `proofFast` *reads* an annotation to decide "definitely a proof" —
   328  and derive `DefEq env d (.fvar i ty) (.fvar i' ty')` for every
   329  `i`, `i'`, which no model satisfies.  The recursive-structure rules
   330  (`redL`, `natSucc`, `eta`, `structUnit`) are therefore not a
   331  proof-engineering convenience but what keeps the relation sound; the
   332  one chaining that is sound, "reduce, then continue", is `redL`, and
   333  its right-hand and δ variants are derived in `Derived.lean`. -/

    26      ∀ fuel : Nat,
    27        WhnfCoreBridge env fuel ∧ WhnfBridge env fuel ∧ DefEqBridge env fuel ∧

== ConLeche/Kernel/CoreDefs.lean#L438-L446
   438  /-- The certified structural-`Nat` operations.  Six of them
   439  (`add sub mul pow beq ble`) carry a literal fast path; `Nat.pred` is
   440  here without one — it has no fast path (official's `reduce_nat` folds
   441  nothing unary but `Nat.succ`), but `Nat.sub`'s recurrence
   442  `sub x (succ y) = pred (sub x y)` names it, so its own recurrences
   443  must be certified for `sub`'s literal fold to be sound. -/
   444  def natOpNames : List Name :=
   445    [natPredName, natAddName, natSubName, natMulName, natPowName,
   446     natBeqName, natBleName]

== ConLeche/Kernel/CoreDefs.lean#L370-L387
   370  /-! ## Structural-Nat literal acceleration
   371  
   372  The official kernel accelerates the structural `Nat` operations on
   373  literals (GMP-backed there).  Here the fast path is *certified*: an
   374  operation participates only when its defining recurrence equations
   375  hold by definitional equality — checked once, at install: `checkDecl`
   376  positively rejects a nonstandard definition under one of these names,
   377  so *presence in the store is the certificate* (no runtime flag, no
   378  re-checking; a reduction-time re-check would in fact livelock — the
   379  certification's own `pred zero` equation re-enters the fast path).
   380  
   381  The certification runs in the environment *before* the operation is
   382  stored, on the equations with the operation's self-references replaced
   383  by its (annotated) definition value (`Expr.substConst0`): running it
   384  after insertion would let the operation's own just-enabled fast path
   385  discharge its all-literal-argument equations (`pred zero ≡ zero`,
   386  `beq zero zero ≡ true`) vacuously — accepting definitions that
   387  disagree with the fast path on those points, which is unsound.  The

   112      if ← ops.isDefEq env 2 eq.1 eq.2 then

   114      else pure false

== ConLeche/Kernel/CoreDefs.lean#L448-L463
   448  /-- The WF-recursive operations with a *pinned-declaration* certified
   449  fast path: at install, `checkDecl` compares the stream's definition
   450  against a vendored pin of the toolchain's own (helper-unfolded)
   451  definition by definitional equality, and then checks the pinned
   452  `Nat.ble`-guarded characterization certificates
   453  (`ConLeche/Kernel/NatOpPins.lean`) like theorem declarations — without
   454  installing them.  Presence in the store is therefore again the
   455  capability: a stored operation under one of these names has passed pin
   456  and certificates, or the install declined.  (The name is historic:
   457  the family started with `Nat.div`/`Nat.mod` and now covers every
   458  pin-certified WF-recursive kernel-accelerated `Nat` operation —
   459  `Nat.log2` left the list when its fast path did, official folding no
   460  unary operation but `Nat.succ`.) -/

   462    [natDivName, natModName, natGcdName, natLandName, natLorName,
   463     natXorName, natShiftLeftName, natShiftRightName]

== ConLeche/SetTheory/Core.lean#L95-L156
    95  /-- A model of set theory of exactly the strength the checker needs:
    96  membership, the six ZF⁻ axioms (extensionality, pairing, union, power
    97  set, regularity, Lean-level replacement), and an ω-chain of
    98  Grothendieck universes.  Infinity is derivable; choice is inherited
    99  from the meta-logic (`Classical.choice`); see the module docstring. -/
   100  class SetTheory (V : Type u) where
   101    /-- Set membership. -/
   102    Mem : V → V → Prop
   103    /-- Extensionality: sets with the same members are equal. -/
   104    ext : ∀ {x y : V}, (∀ z, Mem z x ↔ Mem z y) → x = y
   105    /-- Pairing: the unordered pair. -/
   106    upair : V → V → V
   107    /-- Characterization of the unordered pair. -/
   108    mem_upair : ∀ {z a b : V}, Mem z (upair a b) ↔ z = a ∨ z = b
   109    /-- Union: the union of the members. -/
   110    sUnion : V → V
   111    /-- Characterization of the union. -/
   112    mem_sUnion : ∀ {z x : V}, Mem z (sUnion x) ↔ ∃ y, Mem y x ∧ Mem z y
   113    /-- Power set. -/
   114    power : V → V
   115    /-- Characterization of the power set: members are the subsets. -/
   116    mem_power : ∀ {z x : V}, Mem z (power x) ↔ ∀ w, Mem w z → Mem w x
   117    /-- Regularity: every nonempty set has an `∈`-minimal member. -/
   118    regularity : ∀ x : V, (∃ y, Mem y x) → ∃ y, Mem y x ∧ ¬ ∃ z, Mem z y ∧ Mem z x
   119    /-- Replacement, as a Lean-level scheme: the image of a set under an
   120    arbitrary function `V → V`. -/
   121    image : (V → V) → V → V
   122    /-- Characterization of the replacement image. -/
   123    mem_image : ∀ {f : V → V} {a z : V}, Mem z (image f a) ↔ ∃ w, Mem w a ∧ z = f w
   124    /-- An ω-chain of Grothendieck universes: the sets interpreting the
   125    universe tower (Carneiro's ω-many inaccessibles, op. cit.;
   126    intended model `V_{κ n}`). -/
   127    univChain : Nat → V
   128    /-- The chain increases strictly: each universe is a member of the
   129    next. -/
   130    univChain_mem : ∀ n : Nat, Mem (univChain n) (univChain (n + 1))
   131    /-- Each chain member is a Grothendieck universe (Tarski's Axiom A
   132    matrix with transitivity, `IsTGUniverse`). -/
   133    univChain_tg : ∀ n : Nat, IsTGUniverse Mem (univChain n)
   134  
   135  namespace SetTheory
   136  
   137  @[inherit_doc] scoped infix:50 " ∈ˢ " => Mem
   138  
   139  variable {V : Type u} [SetTheory V]
   140  
   141  /-- Subset, from membership. -/
   142  protected def Subset (x y : V) : Prop := ∀ z, z ∈ˢ x → z ∈ˢ y
   143  
   144  @[inherit_doc] scoped infix:50 " ⊆ˢ " => SetTheory.Subset
   145  
   146  theorem Subset.refl (x : V) : x ⊆ˢ x := fun _ hz => hz
   147  
   148  theorem Subset.trans {x y z : V} (h₁ : x ⊆ˢ y) (h₂ : y ⊆ˢ z) : x ⊆ˢ z :=
   149    fun w hw => h₂ w (h₁ w hw)
   150  
   151  theorem Subset.antisymm {x y : V} (h₁ : x ⊆ˢ y) (h₂ : y ⊆ˢ x) : x = y :=
   152    ext fun z => ⟨h₁ z, h₂ z⟩
   153  
   154  theorem mem_power_iff_subset {z x : V} : z ∈ˢ power x ↔ z ⊆ˢ x := mem_power
   155  
   156  end SetTheory

== ConLeche/Kernel/TrustAxioms.lean#L10-L39
    10  /-!
    11  # The compiler-trust axiom family (task #95)
    12  
    13  `Init`'s compiler-trust scaffolding is installed rather than
    14  declined:
    15  
    16  * `Lean.trustCompiler : True` is trivially realizable — it is
    17    installed as an *opaque* (stored `thmInfo`, exactly like a checked
    18    `opaque` declaration) with value `True.intro`, over a pinned `True`
    19    family.  No new meta-axiom: the model is `True.intro`'s own
    20    interpretation.
    21  * `Lean.reduceNat` / `Lean.reduceBool` then check as ordinary
    22    `opaque`s (their exported values are identity functions modulo the
    23    `have := trustCompiler` wrapper); at install their stored values are
    24    pinned against the identity function
    25    (`ConLeche/Kernel/TrustPins.lean`, hand-pinned since task #273 —
    26    every toolchain's definition after zeta) by definitional equality —
    27    the task-#47 pattern: drift declines, never silently.
    28  * `Lean.ofReduceNat` / `Lean.ofReduceBool` are pinned axioms over
    29    those stored opaques (the task-#34 standard-axioms machinery).  With
    30    the stored reduce operation certified to be the identity (a
    31    definitional-equality certificate at the operation's own install,
    32    `checkReducePin`; the axiom's install checks `ofReduceAxOk`),
    33    `∀ a b, reduceNat a = b → a = b` interprets to
    34    an inhabited proposition (the hypothesis *is* the conclusion), so
    35    both axioms are true in the set model with the proof point as value.
    36  
    37  `sorryAx` remains the only axiom tolerated as a *declaration*: its
    38  record installs nothing and any use of it declines
    39  (`sorryAxName`, `ConLeche/Kernel/Basis/Names.lean`).

== ConLeche/MainTheorem.lean#L110-L117

   111      (pins : List NatOpPinSet) (chunks : List ByteArray)
   112      (h : jsonWithTheoremFalse chunks) :
   113      ∃ e, (do
   114        let pre ← builtinPreludeE
   115        let r ← parseChunks chunks
   116        let ds := preparePrelude pre r.decls
   117        checkDecls .verified pins ds) = .error e := by

== ConLeche/Denotes.lean#L270-L290
   270  structure Model (V : Type w) [SetTheory V] (env : Env) where
   271    /-- the set a constant denotes, per level assignment -/
   272    cval : Name → (LevelParam → Nat) → V
   273    /-- every stored constant is a member of what its type denotes, at
   274    every level assignment (and every variable environment — the type
   275    is closed) -/
   276    mem : ∀ c ∈ env.consts, ∀ (φ : LevelParam → Nat) (ρ : BVarIdx → V),
   277      ∃ T, Denotes cval env φ ρ c.toConstantVal.type T ∧ cval c.name φ ∈ˢ T
   278    /-- whatever the built-in `False` denotes is the empty set -/
   279    false_empty : ∀ (φ : LevelParam → Nat) (ρ : BVarIdx → V) (F : V),
   280      Denotes cval env φ ρ (.const falseName []) F → F = empty
   281    /-- whatever the built-in `Eq` denotes is set equality: at a type `A`
   282    of the universe the level `u` names, and two of its members `a` and
   283    `b`, `@Eq.{u} A a b` denotes the truth value of `a = b`.  The three
   284    membership premises are the graph's domains — `Eq`'s denotation is a
   285    three-fold graph over `univ (Level.eval φ u)`, then over `A`, then
   286    over `A` again, and a graph read off its domain says nothing -/
   287    eq_equality : ∀ (u : Level) (φ : LevelParam → Nat) (ρ : BVarIdx → V) (E A a b : V),
   288      Denotes cval env φ ρ (.const eqName [u]) E →
   289      A ∈ˢ univ (Level.eval φ u) → a ∈ˢ A → b ∈ˢ A →
   290      app (app (app E A) a) b = eqv a b

== ConLeche/SetTheory/Core.lean#L95-L133
    95  /-- A model of set theory of exactly the strength the checker needs:
    96  membership, the six ZF⁻ axioms (extensionality, pairing, union, power
    97  set, regularity, Lean-level replacement), and an ω-chain of
    98  Grothendieck universes.  Infinity is derivable; choice is inherited
    99  from the meta-logic (`Classical.choice`); see the module docstring. -/
   100  class SetTheory (V : Type u) where
   101    /-- Set membership. -/
   102    Mem : V → V → Prop
   103    /-- Extensionality: sets with the same members are equal. -/
   104    ext : ∀ {x y : V}, (∀ z, Mem z x ↔ Mem z y) → x = y
   105    /-- Pairing: the unordered pair. -/
   106    upair : V → V → V
   107    /-- Characterization of the unordered pair. -/
   108    mem_upair : ∀ {z a b : V}, Mem z (upair a b) ↔ z = a ∨ z = b
   109    /-- Union: the union of the members. -/
   110    sUnion : V → V
   111    /-- Characterization of the union. -/
   112    mem_sUnion : ∀ {z x : V}, Mem z (sUnion x) ↔ ∃ y, Mem y x ∧ Mem z y
   113    /-- Power set. -/
   114    power : V → V
   115    /-- Characterization of the power set: members are the subsets. -/
   116    mem_power : ∀ {z x : V}, Mem z (power x) ↔ ∀ w, Mem w z → Mem w x
   117    /-- Regularity: every nonempty set has an `∈`-minimal member. -/
   118    regularity : ∀ x : V, (∃ y, Mem y x) → ∃ y, Mem y x ∧ ¬ ∃ z, Mem z y ∧ Mem z x
   119    /-- Replacement, as a Lean-level scheme: the image of a set under an
   120    arbitrary function `V → V`. -/
   121    image : (V → V) → V → V
   122    /-- Characterization of the replacement image. -/
   123    mem_image : ∀ {f : V → V} {a z : V}, Mem z (image f a) ↔ ∃ w, Mem w a ∧ z = f w
   124    /-- An ω-chain of Grothendieck universes: the sets interpreting the
   125    universe tower (Carneiro's ω-many inaccessibles, op. cit.;
   126    intended model `V_{κ n}`). -/
   127    univChain : Nat → V
   128    /-- The chain increases strictly: each universe is a member of the
   129    next. -/
   130    univChain_mem : ∀ n : Nat, Mem (univChain n) (univChain (n + 1))
   131    /-- Each chain member is a Grothendieck universe (Tarski's Axiom A
   132    matrix with transitivity, `IsTGUniverse`). -/
   133    univChain_tg : ∀ n : Nat, IsTGUniverse Mem (univChain n)

== bridge/lean4lean-model/ConLecheBridge/Carneiro.lean#L200-L202
   200  theorem carneiro_implies_conleche :
   201      OmegaInaccessibles.{u} → Nonempty (Σ V : Type (u + 1), ConLeche.SetTheory V) :=
   202    fun h => ⟨⟨ZFSet.{u}, setTheoryOfCarneiro h⟩⟩
